text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear priorities. First, plan your time carefully by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting mini-deadlines. Next, decide which tasks are most important, so you focus on urgent work first. Scope management is also essential: understand exactly what is required and avoid adding extra work that was not agreed. Finally, communicate openly with your team or manager. If a problem appears, say so early instead of waiting until the last moment. By combining planning, prioritization, clear scope and honest communication, you can meet deadlines with less stress and produce better results.
